description: This Java class defines Swagger API documentation models for authentication request and response payloads in the Fineract project. It includes nested static classes annotated for Swagger schema generation, representing the structure of authentication API calls.

classes.name: AuthenticationApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Final class providing Swagger schema definitions for authentication API request and response models, with nested static classes for request and response structures.

classes.name: PostAuthenticationRequest
classes.description: Inner static class representing the payload for authentication requests, including username and password fields.

classes.name: PostAuthenticationResponse
classes.description: Inner static class representing the response payload after authentication, including user details, roles, permissions, and session info.
